itinerary.title: ARRIVAL HANOI – HA LONG BAY CRUISE Arrive Hanoi airport, the driver will pick up and direc
itinerary.description: CRUISE Arrive Hanoi airport, the driver will pick up and direct transfer to Ha Long bay, which is about 160 km or 2.5-hour drive away. Stop half way to visit a handicraft workshop of fine clothes and embroidered paintings. Arrive in Ha Long City at 11:30 AM and check in aboard the booked junk right after the welcome drink is Served. Start cruising while having lunch on board and enjoy the mighty bay view. Ha Long Bay meaning Descending Dragon Bay in Vietnamese as legend has it that it was where a holly dragon landed down from sky. The bay cruise will continue with up close sighting of Dinh Huong Island, Ga Choi Island, Dog Island, Sail Island, a visit to Sung Sot Cave and swimming stop at Titov Beach. Relax to enjoy the bay view at sunset, have dinner after, go fishing at 09:00 PM and spend a night on board.

itinerary.title: HA LONG BAY – HANOI Start your morning with a relaxing Tai Chi session on the cruise deck
itinerary.description: Start your morning with a relaxing Tai Chi session on the cruise deck while enjoying sunrise views. After breakfast, continue cruising before enjoying a brunch onboard. Disembark and transfer back to Hanoi. Check into your hotel and enjoy the rest of the evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: HANOI CITY TOUR After breakfast, explore the cultural highlights of Vietnam's capital. Vis

itinerary.description: After breakfast, explore the cultural highlights of Vietnam's capital. Visit the Ho Chi Minh Complex, One Pillar Pagoda, and the historic Temple of Literature. Continue to the picturesque Hoan Kiem Lake and Ngoc Son Temple before strolling through the bustling Old Quarter. End your day at the famous Train Street while enjoying a cup of Vietnamese coffee (at your own expense).

itinerary.title: HANOI – DA NANG – HOI AN ANCIENT TOWN
itinerary.description: TOWN Morning, transfer to the airport for your flight to Da Nang. Upon arrival in Da Nang, meet your tour leader and proceed to Hoi An Ancient Town. En route, enjoy a Basket Boat Tour at Cam Thanh Coconut Village, where you will be warmly welcomed by the local people. Cruise through the peaceful coconut waterways in traditional basket boats, learn the art of crab fishing, and witness the entertaining basket boat spinning performances by the local rowers. In the afternoon, explore the charming Hoi An Ancient Town, visiting its famous attractions including the Japanese Covered Bridge, Pottery Museum, 200-year- old Tan Ky Ancient House, Chua Ong Pagoda, and the bustling local market. Enjoy a leisurely walking tour through the narrow streets lined with beautifully preserved ancient houses and traditional assembly halls that reflect Hoi An's rich multicultural heritage.

itinerary.location: FULL DAY BA NA HILLS & GOLDEN BRIDGE Aft
itinerary.description: BRIDGE After breakfast, you will be picked up from your hotel in Da Nang and transferred to the breathtaking Ba Na Hills. Begin your journey with a ride on one of the world's longest and most scenic cable cars from Suoi Mo Cable Car Station to Marseille Station, offering spectacular panoramic views of the surrounding mountains and lush forests. Upon arrival, visit the world-famous Golden Bridge, an architectural masterpiece supported by two giant stone hands, providing stunning views of the hills below. Continue to Jardin D’Amour, a beautifully landscaped flower garden adorned with colorful blooms, fountains, and artistic sculptures. Later, visit the serene Linh Ung Pagoda, home to the magnificent statue of the Goddess of Mercy. In the afternoon, enjoy leisure time at Fantasy Park, one of Vietnam's largest indoor amusement parks, featuring exciting rides, games, and attractions suitable for visitors of all ages. Conclude your day with breathtaking panoramic views from King Peak, located at an altitude of 1,487 metres, before returning to your hotel in Da Nang.

itinerary.description: SIGIRIYA (04 HOURS/ 30 MIN/ 30 ℃ – 32℃) Arrive at Colombo Bandaranayke International Airport. Here, you will be met by a designated guide. From Divas Sojourn. After a warm welcome at the airport, you will be escorted to you. Luxury air- conditioned vehicle and then proceed to Habarana. Activities Covered  Visit the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage  Visit the Dambulla Cave & Gold Temple  Evening visits the Minneriya National Park Jeep Safari Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage A highlight for wildlife lovers, Pinnawala is the world's most renowned elephant orphanage and conservation center. The main attraction is watching dozens of these majestic animals being led to the river twice daily for their public bath—a truly unforgettable spectacle as they play, splash, and socialize in the water Dambulla Cave & Golden Temple A UNESCO World Heritage Site, the Dambulla Cave Temple is a spectacular complex of five caves dating back to the 1st century BC. Perched on a massive rock, it is the largest and best-preserved cave temple complex in Sri Lanka. The site is renowned for its breathtaking interior, which houses over 150 stunning statues and murals of Buddha and various deities, covering virtually every inch of the cave ceilings and walls. The climb to the caves offers panoramic views of the surrounding plains, including the iconic Sigiriya Rock in the distance. Minneriya National Park Famous for one of the world's most spectacular wildlife phenomena, Minneriya National Park is a premier safari destination. During the dry season hundreds of Asian elephants congregate on the grasslands surrounding the ancient Minneriya Tank to feed, bathe, and socialize. Even outside this peak period, the park offers excellent elephant sightings, along with other wildlife such as sambar deer, toque maca…

itinerary.description: After the breakfast at the hotel, proceed to Kandy Activities Covered  Visit the Sigiriya Lion Rock, UNESCO world heritage site  Visit the Village Tour to have village house lunch.  Visit the Nalanda Gedige  Visit the Spice & Herbal Garden  Enjoy a Cultural Dance Show Sigiriya (Lion Rock) A UNESCO World Heritage Site and Sri Lanka's most iconic landmark, Sigiriya is an ancient rock fortress and palace ruin rising dramatically 200 meters from the central plains. Built in the 5th century by King Kasyapa, this "Eighth Wonder of the World" is a breathtaking feat of ancient engineering, urban planning, and artistry Village Experience A village tour in Habarana offers an authentic and immersive glimpse into the traditional rural life of Sri Lanka's countryside. It's a hands-on cultural experience that provides a peaceful contrast to the historical sites and wildlife safaris. Typically, the tour involves a bullock cart ride through lush paddy fields, a tranquil catamaran (reed boat) ride on a local lake, and a visit to a family home. Kandyan Cultural Dance Show A traditional Kandyan cultural dance show. The colorful costumes, rhythmic music, and impressive athleticism make it an entertaining and visually spectacular introduction to Sri Lankan art forms. MELAS- BREAKFAST & DINNER Nalanda Gedige Nalanda Gedige is a unique and enigmatic ancient stone temple, often described as Sri Lanka's best-preserved medieval stone building. Dating between the 8th and 11th centuries, it showcases a remarkable fusion of Hindu and Buddhist architecture, with elements reminiscent of South Indian temples and classical Sinhalese design. itinerary.description: ℃ – 14℃) After the breakfast at the hotel, proceed to Nuwaraeliya Activities Covered  Visit the Temple of the Tooth  Visit the Gems Museum  Visit the Peradeniya Botanical Gardens  Visit the Ramboda Water Falls  Visit the Tea Factory & Gardens Temple of the Tooth Located in the heart of Kandy, this is the most sacred Buddhist temple in Sri Lanka. It is built around a revered relic—the tooth of the Buddha—and is a living center of worship and a UNESCO world heritage site. The temple complex is a place of immense spiritual energy, featuring ornate architecture, intricate wood carvings, and beautiful murals depicting the relic's history. The highlight is witnessing the daily ceremonial rituals where the casket containing the relic is venerated with great devotion amidst chanting and drumming. Kandy Gems Museum & Workshop Visit to a Gems Museum in Kandy offers a fascinating insight into one of Sri Lanka's most famous industries. These venues typically showcase the journey of a gem from a rough stone mined from the earth to a beautifully cut and polished jewel. The tour often includes a demonstration of the cutting and polishing process, an explanation of how to identify different gemstones, and a display of both raw and finished stones, highlighting Sri Lanka's famous sapphires, rubies, and cat's eyes. Royal Botanic Gardens, Peradeniya Located near Kandy, the Royal Botanic Gardens are the finest and most extensive of their kind in Sri Lanka. Spanning 147 acres and beautifully set in a loop of the Mahaweli River, the gardens are a serene paradise of meticulously maintained lawns, pavilions, and a vast collection of tropical and subtropical flora. itinerary.description: After the breakfast at the hotel, proceed to Bentota Activities Covered  Enjoy a Rawana Waterfall  Enjoy a Diyaluma Waterfall  Visit the Buduruwagala Temple  Enjoy a Yala National Park Jeep Safari 02hours/45minutes Temp. 30 ℃ – 32℃) Rawana Waterfall One of Sri Lanka's most iconic and widest waterfalls, Ravana Falls is a spectacular sight, especially during the rainy season. Plunging approximately 25 meters in a dramatic cascade, it is named after the legendary demon king Ravana from the Ramayana epic. According to the myth, this is the area where Ravana hid the kidnapped Princess Sita in the caves behind the waterfall. Diyaluma Falls As the second-tallest waterfall in Sri Lanka, plunging approximately 220 meters, Diyaluma Falls is a breathtaking natural spectacle. Located near the town of Koslanda in the Badulla District, it has become a premier destination for adventure seekers and nature lovers. Unlike many waterfalls that are only viewed from a distance, the unique appeal of Diyaluma is the ability to hike to the top, where a series of stunning natural infinity pools offer a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to swim while overlooking the dramatic escarpment and the plains below. Buduruwagala Meaning "the rock of Buddhist sculptures," Buduruwagala is an ancient and serene rock temple dating back to the 9th or 10th century. It features seven magnificent figures carved into a single large rock face, making it home to the tallest ancient Buddha statues in Sri Lanka. The central standing Buddha figure, at about 16 meters tall, is flanked by two groups of bodhisattvas. Yala National Park Yala is Sri Lanka's most famous and visited national park, renowned for having one of the highest densities of leopards in the world. This living monument is a captivating blend of European architecture and South Asian traditions, perched on a peninsula overlooking the Indian Ocean. Turtle Hatcheries Turtle hatcheries along Sri Lanka's south-west coast are conservation projects dedicated to protecting endangered sea turtles. They work by collecting eggs from vulnerable beaches, incubating them in a safe environment, and releasing the hatchlings into the ocean to increase their survival rates. Madu Ganga River Safari The Madu Ganga, located near Bentota, is a pristine mangrove estuary and a Ramsar Wetland site, known for its rich biodiversity and tranquil beauty. A boat safari through its labyrinthine waterways offers a peaceful escape into nature.

itinerary.title: () TBILISI OLD CITY TOUR & CHRONICLES OF GEORGIA After breakfast, begin the Tbilisi sights
itinerary.location: () TBILISI OLD CITY TOUR & CHRONICLES OF
itinerary.description: GEORGIA After breakfast, begin the Tbilisi sightseeing tour at 10:00 AM. Visit Sameba Cathedral and explore the historic Old City, starting with Abanotubani, famous for its sulfur baths and charming old houses. Continue towards the Juma Mosque area and walk through the narrow streets of Old Tbilisi. Proceed to Kartlis Deda, offering panoramic views over the city. Explore Meidan Bazaar, an atmospheric underground market offering Georgian souvenirs, traditional crafts and local products. Continue to Sharden Street, known for its cafés, shops and charming lanes, and visit the iconic Gabriadze Clock Tower. Explore Rike Park and walk across the famous Bridge of Peace. Continue to Metekhi, located on a high cliff with beautiful panoramic views of Tbilisi. Later, visit the Chronicles of Georgia, an impressive monument overlooking the Tbilisi Sea and depicting important scenes from Georgian history. Lunch can be arranged at the guests' preferred restaurant on direct payment basis. After sightseeing, return to the hotel or city centre. Evening is free at leisure.

itinerary.title: () TBILISI – ANANURI – GUDАURI – KAZBEGI – TBILISI After breakfast, depart at 10:00 AM for
itinerary.description: – TBILISI After breakfast, depart at 10:00 AM for an exciting journey along the Georgian Military Highway. Enjoy spectacular mountain landscapes while visiting Zhinvali Reservoir, a picturesque water reservoir surrounded by mountains. Continue to Ananuri Fortress, a historic medieval fortress complex and former stronghold of the Dukes of Aragvi. Proceed to the Gudauri Friendship Monument and enjoy breathtaking panoramic views of the Caucasus Mountains. Continue to Kazbegi/Stepantsminda and take a 4x4 Jeep ride to Gergeti Trinity Church, one of Georgia's most iconic landmarks. Lunch can be arranged at the guests' preferred restaurant on direct payment basis. Return to Tbilisi in the evening.

itinerary.title: () TBILISI – KAKHETI – BODBE – SIGHNAGHI – TBILISI After breakfast, depart at 10:00 AM for
itinerary.description: – TBILISI After breakfast, depart at 10:00 AM for the beautiful Kakheti Wine Region. Visit the Monastery of St. Nino at Bodbe, an important pilgrimage site associated with St. Nino. Continue to Sighnaghi, a charming hilltop town known for its cobblestone streets, traditional architecture and spectacular views of the Alazani Valley. Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant overlooking the Alazani Valley on direct payment basis. Spend some time exploring the town and enjoying its picturesque surroundings before returning to Tbilisi in the evening.

itinerary.title: () TBILISI – BAGRATASHEN – HAGHPAT – SANAHIN – DILIJAN – LAKE SEVAN – YEREVAN After crossi
itinerary.description: – SANAHIN – DILIJAN – LAKE SEVAN – YEREVAN After crossing the Georgia–Armenia border at Bagratashen, begin your Armenian journey through the spectacular landscapes of Lori Province. The route takes you through forested mountains and the dramatic Debed Gorge, offering a beautiful introduction to Armenia. Visit Haghpat Monastery, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the finest examples of medieval Armenian architecture. Continue to Sanahin Monastery, another remarkable medieval complex that was once an important centre of education, theology and manuscript production. Both monasteries preserve centuries of Armenian spiritual and intellectual heritage through their atmospheric stone churches and courtyards. Continue south through the mountains towards Dilijan, one of Armenia's most picturesque resort towns. Surrounded by the forests of Dilijan National Park, the town is known for its peaceful atmosphere, traditional architecture and artisan heritage. In the afternoon, continue to Lake Sevan, one of Armenia's most scenic destinations. Visit the Sevan Peninsula and Sevanavank Monastery, while enjoying panoramic views of the beautiful lake. Continue towards Yerevan and arrive in the late afternoon. Check in at the hotel and relax.

itinerary.title: () YEREVAN – GEGHARD – SYMPHONY OF THE STONES – GARNI – YEREVAN CITY TOUR After breakfast,
itinerary.description: STONES – GARNI – YEREVAN CITY TOUR After breakfast, proceed for a full-day excursion. Visit Geghard Monastery, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and an impressive medieval monastery partially carved into the surrounding rock. Continue to the Symphony of the Stones, a spectacular natural basalt formation in the Garni Gorge. Visit Garni Temple, the only surviving pagan temple in Armenia, dating back to the 1st century AD. Enjoy a traditional Lavash Baking Master Class followed by lunch featuring homemade Armenian cuisine. Return to Yerevan and begin the city tour, including Abovyan Street, Charles Aznavour Square, Opera House, Swan Lake, Arno Babajanyan Monument, France Square and Cascade Complex, offering panoramic views of Yerevan.

itinerary.description: CAVE – NORAVANK – YEREVAN After breakfast, we begin with the sacred Khor Virap Monastery, offering breathtaking views of the snow-capped Mount Ararat, the eternal symbol of Armenia. Once a royal prison, it is remembered as the place where Gregory the Illuminator endured 13 years of confinement before bringing Christianity to the nation. The journey continues to Areni, a charming village renowned as the cradle of Armenia’s finest wines. We then arrive at the magnificent Noravank Monastery, a 13th-century masterpiece set dramatically against crimson cliffs, where the elegant St. Astvatsatsin Church rises with timeless grace.
